summary: Aduro Clean Technologies filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a US$15.64 million underwritten public offering of 1,028,645 common shares at US$15.20 per share. Canaccord Genuity acted as sole bookrunning manager. Net proceeds will fund a demonstration-scale plant, R&D, and working capital. The offering was made under an F-10 shelf registration and Canadian base shelf prospectus. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
